common_promises: Matched in 24-48 hours (Zirtual, Double, Wing, Viva Talent, Assist World)
US-based college-educated assistants (BELAY, Boldly, Zirtual, Time etc, Worxbee, Squared Away)
Top X% of applicants accepted (ranges from 0.5% to 3% — all claim selectivity)
No long-term contracts / cancel anytime (nearly universal except Athena)
AI-fluent / AI-enhanced assistants (BELAY, Boldly, Athena, Wing, Double)
Save 15-40 hours per month (common ROI claim)
Dedicated (not pooled) assistant (premium tier differentiator vs Fancy Hands, Magic pooled)
common_page_structures: Homepage: hero with time-savings CTA + comparison table (them vs 'others')
How it works: 3-step process (tell us / get matched / start working)
Services/roles pages: EA, bookkeeping, marketing, etc.
Pricing page: some publish openly, many require consultation call
Blog: heavy SEO content — competitor comparisons, cost guides, how-to delegation content
Trust section: client logos, press mentions, review counts, certifications
Free consultation CTA dominant across all sites
gaps_nobody_fills: Local in-person hybrid support: no national player offers blended remote + local presence in major metros (Houston, Dallas, etc.) — pure remote is universal
Industry-specific EA agencies for specific verticals (legal, healthcare, real estate EA specifically at executive level) — most offer these as add-ons not specialization
Transparent pricing + US-based talent under $2,000/month: the under-$2K US-based tier has only Time etc (lower seniority) — the premium US-based EA space has a $2,600 floor
On-demand / surge capacity with US talent: no US-based service offers true on-demand hourly without a monthly commitment
Executive community / peer matching: no service matches executives with EAs from their own industry or peer networks
Risk-free trial with full money-back: most offer rematches but not true money-back guarantees for unhappy clients after work begins
Hybrid concierge model (local errands + remote EA): international companies like DonnaPro target this but no US domestic player serves the in-person hybrid need
Certified EA specializations: no player prominently features certified/credentialed EAs (PACE, CAP certification) as a differentiator
Fractional EA specifically for Houston or Texas market: no geo-targeted brand serves this niche nationally while emphasizing local cultural/timezone alignment

methodology_notes: Research conducted 2026-09-07 using Exa.ai Search (keyword and neural modes, 8 search queries) and ExaContents (URL fetching, ~12 URLs). Traffic data sourced from Exa entity webTraffic field (Jun 2026 trailing month figures) — these are approximate and flagged as such throughout. Pricing data sourced from competitor websites directly where published, or from third-party comparison articles (Wishup, Carly, MyVirtualMate, Worxbee comparison pages) where not published. All third-party pricing is flagged as approximate and should be verified directly with each vendor. Sites that returned errors: belaysolutions.com/pricing (404), equivity.com (404). Sites not retrieved: priorityva.com, assistantly.com, greatassistant.com — manual browser verification recommended. Domain Rating (DR) not retrieved due to Ahrefs/SEMrush access restrictions in this research session. Traffic figures from Exa entity data are the Jun 2026 trailing month value and are labeled approximate. No figures were guessed; all nulls represent genuinely unavailable data.
